usedFor: Zoho Backstage holds events and attendees, Google Drive holds files, and “New Attendee” can start “Copy a File”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Attendee” in Zoho Backstage, then “Copy a File” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: A new attendee triggers a copy of a Google Drive file into a selected folder, with an optional new name.

watchOut: “Share File With Anyone” opens a file by link, so use “Share File” for a private file.
